operation.name: InsertGBVAttachment_ELRP
operation.query: SET @ReturnValue = 0; INSERT INTO [GBVAttachment_ELRP] ([GBVmainID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@GBVMainID ,@Filename ,@FileAttached ,@ContentType ,@CreationUserID ,@LastModificationTimestamp ,@LastModificationUserID ,0); SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); UPDATE [GBVMain_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @CreationUserID ,[ConsentSigned] = 1 WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID

operation.name: GetGBVAttachments_ELRP
operation.query: SELECT [GBVAttachmentID] ,[GBVMainID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] FROM [GBVAttachment_ELRP] WHERE [Deleted] = 0 AND [GBVMainID] = @GBVMainID order by [GBVAttachmentID] ASC

operation.name: DeleteGBVAttachment_ELRP
operation.query: IF(NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVAttachmentID FROM GBVAttachment_ELRP WHERE DELETED = 0 AND GBVMainID = @GBVMainID)) SET @ReturnValue = 0; ELSE BEGIN UPDATE [GBVAttachment_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID UPDATE [GBVMain_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[ConsentSigned] = 0 WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID SET @ReturnValue = 1; END

operation.name: GetGBVAttachment_ELRP
operation.query: SELECT top 1 [GBVAttachmentID] ,[GBVmainID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] FROM [GBVAttachment_ELRP] WHERE [Deleted] = 0 AND [GBVMainID] = @GBVMainID order by GBVAttachmentID desc
